notes: 1) LOADER ROUTING: FrameXML/UIParent.lua:327 only loads THIS addon for default (stock) classes, or for heroes when C_Config.GetBoolConfig("CONFIG_LEGACY_CHARACTER_ADVANCEMENT_ENABLED") == false and CA_FORCE_LEGACY is not set; nil/true routes to Ascension_CharacterAdvancementSeason9 and CoA classes (IsCustomClass) to Ascension_CoATalents. The shim's C_Config must answer false for that key (or the shim pins CharacterAdvancement_LoadUI) to get this UI for a Hero character. 2) TWO CHARACTER AXES drive every branch: C_Player:IsHero() (classFile == "HERO" via the 4-return UnitClassBase override) vs C_Player:IsDefaultClass() (Enum.ClassMask.DEFAULT) - default classes get a 70px shorter frame, no class navigation, Reset All Talents instead of Reset Build, previewCharacterAdvancementChanges forced to 1 (pending-build editing) and CA_USE_GATES_DEBUG = true; heroes get the class bookmark navigation, Abilities/Talents/Mastery/Summary tabs, the rarity flyout when CONFIG_CHARACTER_ADVANCEMENT_QUALITIES_ENABLED else preview mode + gates. 3) PREVIEW MODE: CVar previewCharacterAdvancementChanges == "1" switches learn/unlearn to the client-side pending build (CanAddByEntryID/AddByEntryID/CanRemoveByEntryID/RemoveByEntryID, Save = CharacterAdvancementUtil.ConfirmApplyPendingBuild -> ApplyPendingBuild, Undo = CancelPendingBuild) and, through the wrappers in FrameXML/Util/GlobalOverwrites.lua:355-420, silently redirects GetGlobalAEInvestment/GetGlobalTEInvestment/GetTabTEInvestment/GetClassPointInvestment/CanLearnID/CanUnlearnID to their GetPending*/CanAdd/CanRemove counterparts - the shim must implement BOTH names of each pair, and the wrappers themselves live in compat/FrameXML (GlobalOverwrites.lua). Non-preview mode goes straight to LearnID/UnlearnID with the CONFIRM_LEARN_S/CONFIRM_UNLEARN_S popups (ShouldConfirmLearnID/ShouldConfirmUnlearnID reasons). 4) GAME MODES: every Draft/WildCard/BuildDraft path is guarded by C_GameMode:IsGameModeActive (GetCustomGameMode bitmask); returning Enum.GameMode.None (0) keeps WildCard_LoadUI, TokenUtil, C_Wildcard, DraftUtil.HasAnyPicks and the rapid-roll button off the critical path. CharacterAdvancementUtil.CanUseBrowser() needs CONFIG_ABILITY_BROWSER_ENABLED AND IsAnyGameModeActive(), so with mode None the ability browser (caLastClass == "BROWSER") is unreachable and the addon falls back to SelectClass("WARRIOR") - but InitializeSpellTagFilter still calls GetRootSpellTagTypes/GetSpellTagTypes at OnLoad, so those must at least return empty tables. 5) EVENT DELIVERY: all 16 custom events are native frame events (api-surface __EVENT__ NATIVE) registered with Frame:RegisterEvent and dispatched by OnEventToMethod; SharedXML/C_Hook.lua additionally mirrors every event to C_Hook listeners from a RegisterAllEvents frame, and TokenUtil/SpecializationUtil consume TOKEN_UPDATED / ASCENSION_CA_SPECIALIZATION_ACTIVE_ID_CHANGED via EventRegistry - the DESIGN EventBus must feed frames that registered the name (per-frame OnEvent) and also C_Hook:SendEvent. CHARACTER_ADVANCEMENT_PENDING_BUILD_UPDATED is registered by EVERY visible spell/talent button and branch texture (OnShow) - firing it re-runs SetEntry on all of them, so batch it. 6) ENTRY RECORD CONTRACT: see GetEntryByInternalID; talents are laid out at x = -84 + (Column-1)*52 (+shift), y = yStart + Row*44 with Row 0-based and Column 1-based; entry.ConnectedNodes lists PARENT entry ids (child -> parent) and CATalentFrameGatesMixin derives each row's gate thresholds from the top-left node's RequiredTEInvestment/RequiredTabTEInvestment; unroutable or unknown parents are logged with C_Logger.Error, never fatal. Icons are file names without the Interface\\Icons\\ prefix; entry.Class/Tab are DBC display names mapped by CharacterAdvancementUtil.ClassConversions. 7) C_ClassInfo.GetSpecInfo(classFile, specFile) is dereferenced without nil checks for all 30 (class,spec) pairs and must return {Name, SpecFilename}. 8) SPELL RESOLUTION: every button pcall's GetSpellInfo(entry.Spells[rank]) and the tooltip is GameTooltip:SetHyperlink("spell:ID"); if the stock client lacks those spell ids in Spell.dbc the buttons render as 'Broken Spell' - either ship the CA spell DBC patch or override GetSpellInfo/tooltips from the generated tables (Name/Icon are already in the entry record). 9) CVARS: caLastClass/caLastSpec (character) and previewCharacterAdvancementChanges are created by native RegisterSavedCVar (FrameXML/GameCVars.lua:61-62,114); on stock, back C_CVar.Get/Set/GetBool for these names with SavedVariables - the addon writes them dozens of times per session and reads them in every FullUpdate. 10) SOUND: PlaySound is fed numeric SOUNDKIT ids/tables through the SharedOverwrites.lua override; map to 3.3.5 names (e.g. UCHATSCROLLBUTTON -> igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn, CHARACTER_SHEET_TAB -> igCharacterInfoTab) or no-op. 11) MISSING-ON-STOCK GLOBALS: SendSystemMessage (no Lua definition anywhere; not in either inventory -> provide via DEFAULT_CHAT_FRAME:AddMessage), Internal_CopyToClipboard (native-only; degrade Share Build), IsSpellIDKnown, GetCustomGameMode, GetRealmMaxLevel, RegisterSavedCVar, C_Aura.UnitHasAura (Prestige aura 9930831 -> UnitBuff scan). 12) ITEMS: essence/mark/scroll counts come from GetItemCount on custom item ids and their tooltips from item hyperlinks - if the stock client cannot resolve the items, override CurrencyBarMixin/RefreshCurrencies to read the ESSENCE budget from the shim (DESIGN section 5 ESSENCE line) instead. 13) FRAME POOLS: all spell/talent/branch/gate/browser buttons are created lazily by CreateFramePool on first Acquire, so their template OnLoad code (UseQuality, SetAtlas, BorderIcon setup) and the SetEntry native chain run at first FullUpdate (OnShow), not at addon load;
